shared_elements: low relief carving on a rectangular slab
stylized plant/floral motif (lotus-like buds and rosette-like flowers in A's scene furnishings vs B's plants)
winged/radiating symmetrical form (winged disc in A; palmette fans in B)
justification: Both are low-relief slabs with stylized vegetal forms — A includes lotus/papyrus-like plant details and a symmetrical winged emblem, while B is entirely a vertical vine with palmette-like fanning flowers and volute buds. The decisive difference is that A depicts a narrative human scene (standing and seated figures facing one another, offering gestures) plus multiple lines of script in horizontal registers, none of which appears in B, whose content is purely a repeating floral scroll.
